title: Ahsoka Tano
subtitle: Jedi
description: Ahsoka Tano was a courageous Jedi Knight during the era of the Clone Wars. Amid controversy, Tano walked away from the Jedi Order, instead choosing to forge her own path. Years later, Tano worked with the rebel crew of the Ghost. After the disappearance of Ezra Bridger and Grand Admiral Thrawn, Ahsoka traversed the galaxy in search of her lost friend.
